transfertpro.title: Apprenticeship at
transfertpro.description: Full stack developer on a file-transfer SaaS certified CSPN by the French ANSSI. Tech lead on the Tsend frontend rebuild: migration from a legacy .NET Razor/Vue codebase to Next.js + shadcn/ui in a Turbo monorepo, full dockerisation with a single image serving both the cloud and on-premise customers, and a CI/CD pipeline that cut production releases from 45 min down to 3 min (15× faster).
